Good morning coach. Before you answer anything else, fetch my wellness for the last 7 days and my athlete profile, then tell me how my recovery is trending.
Current time: Monday, July 6th, 1998 - 09:00 (UTC) / 1998-07-06 09:00 UTC

Good morning. Your recovery is **trending positively** after a small midweek dip:

- HRV fell to 68 on July 3, then rose to 73 and 75 over the last two entries.
- Resting HR peaked at 49 bpm, then returned to 46 bpm—close to your 47 bpm profile baseline.
- Sleep improved from roughly 7 hours to 8 hours.
- Fitness and Fatigue remained steady at 55 and 48, leaving Form at a fresh **+7**.

The latest entry is yesterday, July 5, so the data is current. Overall, you appear well recovered, assuming your legs and general energy feel normal today. One data-quality note: wellness lists 75 kg, while your athlete profile lists 70 kg.
